meta.description: Handoff: sets human takeover, stops AI, cancels follow-ups, creates a Salesforce Task, posts a Slack summary, optionally sends one approved transfer message. Also handles deterministic opt-out and wrong-number suppression flows. Resume: authorized webhook trigger only, with full recheck and audit.

options.$comment: Skipped naturally when recordId is null (unknown caller opt-out is still honored at the Sendblue layer below).
Runs only on the opt_out branch (see IF below feeding this node). Sendblue blocks sends to opted-out numbers at its layer too (ASSUMPTIONS A-08).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries({ Subject: $json.taskSubject, Priority: $json.priority, Status: 'Open', Description: ('Correlation: ' + $json.correlation_id + '\nReason: ' + ($json.handoff_reason || $json.mode) + '\nUrgency: ' + $json.urgency), WhoId: $json.recordObj === 'Contact' ? $json.recordId : undefined, ActivityDate: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) }).filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined))) }}

options.$comment: Lead tasks: WhoId accepts Lead ids as well; harmless if org restricts — error branch continues.

nodes.name: Dispatch One Transfer/Confirmation Message via SB-06
nodes.notes: Idempotency key = correlation + content, so retries of this workflow cannot send the confirmation twice. Note: SB-06 sends this while the takeover/opt-out flags are already written — it is whitelisted as a reply template; the opt-out confirmation is the single permitted non-promotional confirmation, sent by the dispatcher BEFORE Sendblue-side opt-out enforcement would block (order: SF flags -> this send -> Sendblue opt-out runs in parallel branch; if Sendblue already blocked it, that is an acceptable fail-safe).

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const m = (JSON.parse($env.SF_FIELD_MAP_JSON || '{}').mappings || {}); const obj = $json.recordObj; const fields = ['sms_opt_out','sms_consent','wrong_number','human_takeover'].map(k => m[k]).filter(s => s && s.field !== 'UNMAPPED' && s.object === obj).map(s => s.field); return `SELECT Id${fields.length ? ', ' + fields.join(', ') : ''} FROM ${obj} WHERE Id = '${$json.recordId}'`; })() }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ resumed: $('Clear Takeover + Audit').first().json.resumed, reason: $('Clear Takeover + Audit').first().json.reason || null }) }}

nodes.name: Note: Kill Switch
nodes.notes: Suppression modes here run even when global_ai_enabled=false (opt-outs must always be honored). The one optional outbound confirmation still passes through SB-06, which checks global_ai_enabled/outbound_enabled before sending.

main.node: Dispatch One Transfer/Confirmation Message via SB-06
